title: builtin.action.fire parameters
description: Fires a weapon at the entity stored in a blackboard key (emits Fire) and succeeds in the same tick. Fails, without an intent, if the key is unset or the entity is not a current contact. In this version Fire is only recorded; it has no effect on the target.

target_key.description: Blackboard key of type entity that holds the target (read only).

weapon.description: Weapon label in the namespaced id form, for example example.weapon.main_gun.
